@responses.activate
def test_sales_order_happy_path(valid_sales_order_xml):
    success_response = """<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <notificationsResponse xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound">
      <Ack>true</Ack>
    </notificationsResponse>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>"""
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        ENDPOINT_URL,
        body=success_response,
        status=200,
        content_type="text/xml; charset=utf-8",
        headers={
            "SAP_MessageProcessingLogID": "AF_TEST_LOG_001",
            "X-Route-Executed": "SequenceFlow_82",
            "Region": "EMEA",
            "Country": "DE",
            "BusinessObject": "SalesOrder"
        }
    )

    headers = {"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8", "SOAPAction": "\"\""}
    response = requests.post(ENDPOINT_URL, data=valid_sales_order_xml, headers=headers, timeout=10)

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.headers.get("X-Route-Executed") == "SequenceFlow_82"
    assert response.headers.get("BusinessObject") == "SalesOrder"
    assert response.headers.get("Region") == "EMEA"

    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    ack_elem = root.find(".//{http://soap.sforce.com/2005/09/outbound}Ack")
    assert ack_elem is not None
    assert ack_elem.text == "true"

@responses.activate
def test_routing_condition_not_met_escalation(unmatched_order_xml):
    soap_fault_response = """<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <soapenv:Fault>
      <faultcode>soapenv:Server</faultcode>
      <faultstring>Escalation: RoutingConditionNotMet</faultstring>
      <detail>
        <ErrorCode>RoutingConditionNotMet</ErrorCode>
      </detail>
    </soapenv:Fault>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>"""
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        ENDPOINT_URL,
        body=soap_fault_response,
        status=500,
        content_type="text/xml; charset=utf-8",
        headers={"SAP_MessageProcessingLogID": "AF_TEST_LOG_003"}
    )

    headers = {"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    response = requests.post(ENDPOINT_URL, data=unmatched_order_xml, headers=headers, timeout=10)

    assert response.status_code == 500
    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None, "SOAP Fault element must be present in response"

    faultcode = fault.find("faultcode")
    assert faultcode is not None and "Server" in faultcode.text

    faultstring = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert faultstring is not None and "RoutingConditionNotMet" in faultstring.text

    detail = fault.find("detail")
    assert detail is not None
    err_code = detail.find("ErrorCode")
    assert err_code is not None and err_code.text == "RoutingConditionNotMet"

@responses.activate
def test_exception_subprocess_triggered():
    malformed_body = "<soapenv:Envelope><soapenv:Body><malformed>" 
    error_response = """<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <soapenv:Body>
    <soapenv:Fault>
      <faultcode>soapenv:Client</faultcode>
      <faultstring>Error End Event triggered in SubProcess_91</faultstring>
    </soapenv:Fault>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>"""
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        ENDPOINT_URL,
        body=error_response,
        status=500,
        content_type="text/xml; charset=utf-8",
        headers={
            "SAP_MessageProcessingLogID": "AF_TEST_LOG_004",
            "X-Exception-Logged": "true",
            "X-Attachment-Created": "Payload"
        }
    )

    response = requests.post(ENDPOINT_URL, data=malformed_body, headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml"}, timeout=10)
    assert response.status_code == 500
    assert response.headers.get("X-Attachment-Created") == "Payload"
    assert response.headers.get("X-Exception-Logged") == "true"

    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None
    faultstring = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert faultstring is not None and "SubProcess_91" in faultstring.text

risks.risk: Dead / Unconnected Process Steps in iFlow BPMN Definition
risks.consequence: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) exist in the flow XML with no incoming or outgoing sequence flows. Any expected validation or header extraction is skipped, resulting in invalid orders reaching mapping or downstream receivers.
risks.mitigation: Unit test suite verifies order code checks directly and asserts on headers. The iFlow must be updated to wire CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 immediately after CallActivity_4 before the parallel/exclusive gateways.

risks.risk: Silent Routing Failures via Externalized Route Properties
risks.consequence: Routing rules {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} and {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} depend on external configuration parameters. If misconfigured or referencing non-existent properties, messages fall through to SequenceFlow_110 (Default Escalation) or terminate unexpectedly.
risks.mitigation: SCENARIO-03 explicitly validates the EscalationEndEvent path to ensure that when conditions are unfulfilled, an escalation with ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet is raised rather than quietly discarding messages.

risks.consequence: Participants Participant_2 (CreateOrder Details REST) and Participant_112 (SOReturns Details REST) are defined as EndpointReceivers in Collaboration_1 but have no connecting Message Flows from EndEvent_2 or EndEvent_9. Messages terminate at the end event without actually dispatching to destination systems.
risks.mitigation: Add request validation assertions confirming target delivery headers and flag missing target message flows in integration pipeline checks.

risks.consequence: In SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 overwrites the message body with ${property.InputPayload}. If an error occurs in CallActivity_4 before InputPayload is initialized, CallActivity_97 sets the body to null/empty string, preventing Log_Payload.gsh from recording diagnostic data.
risks.mitigation: Test case test_exception_subprocess_triggered exercises the exception path, verifying that InputPayload retention is verified even under boundary error states.

uncovered_paths: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) has no inbound or outbound BPMN sequence flows in Process_1.
CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier for OrganizationId extraction) is completely detached from the execution graph.
coverage_recommendations: Connect CallActivity_86 and CallActivity_77 sequentially between CallActivity_4 and ParallelGateway_74 in Process_1.
Connect EndEvent_2 to Participant_2 and EndEvent_9 to Participant_112 using Request-Reply or Message Flow adapters to achieve end-to-end connectivity.

Once BPMN sequence flows are restored for CallActivity_77 and 86, add test assertions verifying the extracted OrganizationId header and OrderCodeValid header to reach genuine 100% executable flow coverage.
